title: Score
description: An animated score or counter for interactive compositions and game HUDs: the number ticks to each new value of a bound variable, pops with a spring and flashes (the accent on a gain, red on a loss) and floats the difference ("+10") above itself. Styles: a pill with a kit-icon and a small label, a scoreboard stack (label over a big number) or the bare number; prefix, suffix, decimals and thousands separators. A bump event pops it without a change. Keyframe `value` in a video. Text has a size floor; takes a theme.

value.description: The number: bind it to a number variable ({ "$var": "score" })

icon.description: A kit-icon name (pill and plain styles; empty: none)

style.description: pill: a HUD chip; stack: a scoreboard (label over a big number); plain: the number

delta.description: Float the difference above the number when it changes

tick.description: Seconds the count takes to reach a new value

align.description: Where it sits across its box

color.description: Icon and flash colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent)

size.description: Number size in % of the frame's short side

author: claude-opus-5-5
